Class CustomerMenu

java.lang.Object
menus.CustomerMenu
public class CustomerMenu extends Object
Handles the Customer menu including ticket purchasing, order history, and event viewing.

    • CustomerMenu

      public CustomerMenu(Scanner in, HashMap<Integer,Event> eventMap, DataManager dataManager, User loggedInUser)
      Constructs a CustomerMenu with the required shared state.
      Parameters:
      in - the shared Scanner for console input
      eventMap - the shared map of event ID to Event
      dataManager - the shared DataManager
      loggedInUser - the currently logged-in Customer user

  • Method Details

    • show

      public boolean show()
      Displays the customer menu and handles user choices.
      Returns:
      true if the user logged out

    • purchaseTickets

      public void purchaseTickets()
      Handles ticket purchasing for the logged-in customer. Allows purchasing tickets for multiple events in a single transaction before finalizing. The customer can keep adding events or finalize at any time.

    • calculateTotalCost

      public double calculateTotalCost(int numOfTickets, double admissionPrice)
      Calculates the total cost of tickets including tax and membership discount.
      Parameters:
      numOfTickets - number of tickets the customer wants to buy
      admissionPrice - the price per ticket
      Returns:
      The total cost of the tickets with the Texas sales tax.

    • calculateTax

      public double calculateTax(int numOfTickets, double admissionPrice)
      Calculates the tax portion of a purchase based on the number of tickets, price per ticket, and whether the customer has a membership discount.
      Parameters:
      numOfTickets - number of tickets
      admissionPrice - the price per ticket
      Returns:
      the tax amount rounded to the nearest cent

    • viewEvent

      public void viewEvent()
      Displays a sub-menu allowing the customer to list all events or search for a specific event.
